project.name: VozNativa
project.objective: Brazilian Portuguese voice engine and Agent Skill that rewrites text for a channel, audience and author voice while verifying, before delivery, that facts, negation, modality, quantities, dates, conditions and roles were preserved

audiences: writers using an AI coding/writing agent

targets: Python package and CLI on Windows and Linux
Agent Skill (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI
platform.connectivity: offline core; optional model provider command for rewrite and judge

technologies.name: PyYAML
technologies.role: reference manifests, packs and voice contracts

sensitive_data: user-authored text that may contain personal data
author writing samples used for a voice profile

critical: semantic preservation (no silent change of facts, negation, modality, quantities, dates, conditions, roles)
evidence honesty in reports and benchmarks
privacy of user text in recorded runs
important: reproducibility of eval and benchmark results
no invented regional or identity traits

key_invariants: only identity is accepted automatically; passing the deterministic gates yields no_deterministic_issues with semantic_equivalence unverified
a fail from compare is never overridden by a judge or a reviewer
an LLM judge never resolves review_required; only a signed human review does
if no candidate is safe the engine returns the original
a provider_error is an outcome of its own and never counts as task success
frozen holdouts and benchmark manifests are not edited after their first run
regional markers have effective strength 0 without an evidence pack with provenance; the observed author voice wins over generic regional markers

categories: eval cases written by the developer
benchmark outputs of real model runs
data.retention: recorded runs keep hashes and summaries; --redact removes text, credentials and absolute paths

constraints.budget: paid model runs only with a stated expected value; ptbr-bench-v2 cost US$ 4.64
licensing_restrictions: corpora and third-party skills are used only as their licenses allow; no raw corpus text is copied
repository license not yet decided (Apache-2.0 proposed)

operations.observability: JSON reports with kind and schema_version for every command; benchmark manifests with sha256

task.objective: Harden v0.4.0 (single local qualification runner, benchmark outcome separation, planner and ledger residual cases, performance, privacy) and start v0.5.0 Regional Evidence Packs whose activation requires provenance-backed evidence
in_scope: regional evidence pack contract and its integration
acceptance_criteria: qualification runner preserves each gate's real exit code and distinguishes FAIL, BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, SKIPPED, INCONCLUSIVE and PASS
benchmark reports separate semantic safety, transformation success, provider failure and pending evaluation
a provider_error never counts as a completed task
regionalization abstains without an evidence pack that matches scope, epoch and channel
every behavior fix has a regression test whose oracle is the behavior, not the implementation
assumptions: the developer-written eval cases are not independent evidence
unknowns: real regional evidence sufficient for calibration

claims.statement: CI declared for Linux/Windows 3.11-3.13 is green

evidence.description: local unittest, validator and semantic suites run by the developer on Windows, Python 3.12
workflow declared; no run executed because GitHub Actions is blocked by billing
